name: transparent-stamp-lineart
title_zh: 邮票齿孔外透明、内里不透明的单色线稿生成器
tagline_zh: 照片变邮票线稿，外圈锯齿真正透明、内里不透明。不是普通抠图，是自带邮票边框的黑白版画风。
tagline_en: Photos become black-and-white stamp line art. Outer scallops truly transparent, inner art opaque. Not plain.
desc_en: Convert supplied images into clean monochrome postage-stamp line art, then produce a PNG whose scalloped-border exterior is truly transparent while the interior remains opaque. Use for the established black-and-white stamp or transparent-serrated treatment, not for ordinary background removal without a stamp border.
why_zh: 它把「邮票」和「透明」焊死在一起：外缘齿孔全透明，内部图案不透明，产物直接是 PNG，拿来就能贴。
why_en: It welds stamp and transparency together: scalloped edge fully clear, interior solid. Output is a PNG you can drop anywhere.
limit_zh: 只做黑白单色邮票线稿，彩色或半调效果不做；输入图需清晰，模糊小图会出噪点；产物是 PNG，不负责排版或打印。
limit_en: Only monochrome stamp line art; no color or halftone. Needs a clear input; blurry small images get noisy. Output is PNG only, no layout or print.
title_en: Postage-stamp line art: scalloped border transparent.
